acceptanceCriteria: The number of --traffic files is bounded with a named refusal, and a test covers the bound.
The per-step filter is linear in records, or the spec records the quadratic cost under the 8,192-record bound as accepted.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the AFU-V1 S5 review (PR #201, V1-0252). `corvint flows navigate` accepts any number of `--traffic` files, and the per-step traffic filter is quadratic in records times steps. Today only the 8,192-record bound caps the work.

Tests named in the PR: focused -race appflows traffic bound test; golden unchanged. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). title: flows navigate: bound the number of --traffic files; the per-step traffic filter is quadratic
